about context switching, research in too many tabs or manual busywork Bento grids and feature cards that need a small illustration above the text When not to use Showing real browser content – the windows only contain placeholder blocks Places where the right and bottom edge must stay sharp – the scene fades out there by design Installation Add Tab Overload with the shadcn CLI – your project needs a components.json, see Installation in the docs – or copy the file by hand. Requires React 19.
